# Technical Note: Invoice Reconciliation Demo

## 1. Purpose
This demo illustrates an agentic invoice reconciliation workflow for a mid-size FMCG distributor.

## 2. Architecture
Four agents (intake, matching, exception, summary) process a batch of invoices and POs sequentially.

## 3. Artefacts
- plan.json: structured plan from the Planner agent.
- demo_blueprint.md: primary contract for the demo build.
- production_spec.md: real-deployment specification.
- manifest.json: ordered file list for the Builder.
- review_report.md: static and dynamic review findings.
- RUN.md: setup and demo instructions.
- demo_simulation.html: self-contained browser simulation.

## 4. Mock-to-Production Mapping
The mock layer reads responses from mock_llm_instructions.json. In production, these calls go to a real LLM via the Anthropic API.

## 5. Limitations
- No real OCR pipeline.
- Synthetic data only.

## 6. Next Steps
1. Replace mock LLM layer with real API calls.
2. Add PDF parsing pipeline.
3. Integrate with ERP system.

## 7. References
1. Anthropic. Tool use with Claude. https://docs.anthropic.com
